documents.title: Bambu PC Technical Data Sheet V2.0
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: thermal.heat_deflection_temp: the TDS gives 117 °C at 1.8 MPa and 112 °C at 0.45 MPa (a heavier load normally gives the lower HDT), and the wiki ABS/ASA/PC guide gives 117 ℃ at 0.45 MPa; the TDS 0.45 MPa row (112 °C) is kept with a conflict note for adjudication.

TDS values with no registry key (not stored): Z-direction mechanical values (tensile 56 ± 2 MPa, elongation 2.1 ± 0.4 %, bending modulus 1620 ± 80 MPa, bending strength 55 ± 2 MPa, impact 9.0 ± 0.4 kJ/m²), Young's modulus (X-Y 2110 ± 40 MPa, Z 1450 ± 60 MPa), notched impact X-Y 7.5 ± 1.3 kJ/m², melt index 32.2 ± 2.9 g/10 min (260 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption 0.25 % (25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity < 20% RH, bed surface preparation PVP Glue, retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle ~ 70°, max bridging length ~ 40 mm, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size diameter 200 mm / height 67 mm, and the chemical-resistance rows.

material.spool_type is not curated: the TDS states the spool material (PC + ABS), not a spool type; the store page's Spool option (Filament with spool) and its bullet 'Comes with High Temperature Reusable Spool' are the page layer's.

safety.certifications is neither curated nor declared not_published: the store page links a RoHS document (https://store.bblcdn.com/48b9ce9b1c1440489846d7ea78aaeeff.pdf) that was not in the cache and was not read; the TDS and SDS name no certification.
The hex table publishes the same #FFFFFF for White (60100) and Transparent (60103); recorded as published.
in_the_box: no official text list in the documents read.
